baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate at word 1 governs the Lord's Name at words 2-3 and culminates in honoring at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Blessing is fixed yet increasing good located in a communicative Name; lordship matures that good and honoring carries it outward as noble generosity.

activation_trace.role: Fixed, increasing good gives the predicate both durability and generative force.
Naming as designation and signification locates that good in a communicative Name.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the ongoing process by which the good matures.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity make honoring both intrinsic excellence and outward giving.

changed_reading.before: A closing declaration that the Lord's name is blessed and honored.
changed_reading.after: The Name is the disclosed site where enduring good is continually matured into generous benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1-3 place settling blessing beside a Name whose root inventory also carries elevation and visibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two opposed vectors coexist: good settles and becomes stable while the Name rises into public visibility; sovereign lordship and conferred value make that visible Name an orienting center.

activation_trace.role: Kneeling and settling give blessing a downward motion into stable emplacement.
Rising high gives the Name the counter-motion of elevation.
A raised outline visible from afar turns elevation into public recognizability.
Sovereignty makes the visible Name a center of orientation rather than mere prominence.
Dearness and high value explain why attention is drawn toward that center.

changed_reading.before: Blessed means only exalted, and the Name is only a title.
changed_reading.after: Good settles into reality while the Name rises into view, joining stable presence to visible orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The utterance combines persistent blessing at word 1, naming at word 2, abiding lordship at word 3, and a formula-like honoring at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can perform what it says: its speaker holds fast to the Name, sustains the relation, and voices willing honor rather than merely reporting an attribute.

activation_trace.role: Holding fast and pressing on supplies sustained adherence rather than static possession.
The act of naming gives the utterance its performative object.
Abiding and remaining make the named relation durable.
A formula of willing honor lets the closing clause function as voiced assent.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes blessedness from a distance.
changed_reading.after: Reciting the verse is itself an act of adhering to the Name and answering it with willing honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verse's settling/rising polarity becomes a surah-wide vertical circuit: creatures lower themselves, the sky is raised, measure is placed, and blessing settles while the Name rises.

activation_trace.role: Settling in place anchors the downward pole of the focus mechanism.
Rising high anchors the upward pole in the Name.
Lowering and humility turn the star or stemless growth and tree into active downward participants.
Raising the sky supplies the explicit upward motion that echoes the Name's elevation.
Putting something in a lower or appointed place makes descent ordered emplacement rather than loss of rank.

structural_cues: 55:6 gives a dual prostration to the star or stemless growth and the tree.
55:7 raises the sky and places the balance; 55:10 likewise places the earth for creatures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowering, raising, and appointed placement; I infer one coordinated vertical circuit whose poles meet in 55:78. A live alternative is that these remain separate cosmic acts with no lexical feedback into the closing line.

changed_reading.before: The closing blessing moves only upward as exaltation.
changed_reading.after: The line coordinates two motions: blessing establishes itself below while the Name rises above, making cosmic humility and elevation mutually sustaining.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching, disclosure, calculation, and balance activate the non-dominant mark branch behind the focus Name: the Name becomes a legible signature by which created order is recognized and calibrated.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark turns the Name from a label into a readable signature.
Designation and signification keep the marked-signature reading anchored in naming.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic act by which the signature becomes readable.
Uncovering meaning through speech or sign gives the signature communicative content.
Counting and calculation make cosmic regularity one readable register of the Name.
The balance of justice extends legibility from cosmic measure into ethical calibration.

structural_cues: 55:2-4 sequences teaching revelation, creating the human, and teaching articulation.
55:5-9 moves from celestial calculation to a placed balance and commands against corrupting measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies learning, sign-mediated disclosure, calculation, and just measure; I infer that their common legibility converges on the focus Name as signature. The ordinary designation sense remains fully live, and the mark reading depends on a non-dominant mapped root.

changed_reading.before: The Name is an elevated verbal designation.
changed_reading.after: The Name is also the legible signature of measured creation and justice, teaching the reader how to recognize and calibrate what the surah displays.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal asking and recurring divine activity turn lordship from a title into continuous responsive maintenance; fixed growing good is replenished through acts of repair and completion.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion define lordship as active maintenance.
Fixed yet growing good is the maintained result, not a static stock.
Asking and requesting supply the field of needs to which governance responds.
A recurring span of time makes maintenance continuous rather than exceptional.
Repairing and doing work well gives the recurring affair a constructive direction.

structural_cues: 55:29 places every being in the heavens and earth in a posture of asking, then says that He is in an affair every day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal requests, recurring time, and constructive activity; I infer the arrow request to ongoing maintenance to renewed good. A live alternative is that the daily affair varies independently of those requests rather than answering them.

changed_reading.before: Lordship names a settled rank and blessing a completed endowment.
changed_reading.after: Lordship continually answers creaturely need by repairing and completing, so the blessed good remains stable precisely through ceaseless renewal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-parallel at 55:26-27 distinguishes finite carriers from an abiding divine self-presence; the final Name becomes the addressable and recitable mode by which that abiding presence remains active for the hearer.

activation_trace.role: Designation and signification make the Name available to speech after finite visible bearers disappear.
Fixed, growing good prevents recitable persistence from becoming a merely inert remainder.
Cessation after prior continuance establishes the finitude against which the ending is heard.
Enduring continuation supplies the counter-state that the final blessing recalls.
Face as self or essence keeps what abides from being reduced to a surviving verbal token.

structural_cues: 55:27 and 55:78 repeat the same branchless ج ل ل occurrence at word 5 and the same ر ب ب / ك ر م frame; only وجه versus اسم and ذو versus ذي change.
55:26 immediately precedes the abiding-Face line with the disappearance of everyone upon the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disappearance, an abiding Face-as-self, and a final Name in a nearly identical frame; I infer that the recitable Name mediates relation to abiding presence. The live alternative is formal ring closure with no ontological distinction or mediation between Face and Name.

changed_reading.before: The ending simply repeats the praise of 55:27 with a synonym.
changed_reading.after: After finite forms vanish, the abiding self-presence is not collapsed into the Name, yet the Name remains its blessed, recitable interface for the hearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The basin and fertile-bounty branches in the focus become an ecology: good is retained, released as flowing or gushing water, and converted into green abundance without exhausting its source.

activation_trace.role: Water held in a basin supplies retention and source stability.
Fixed growing good converts retained supply into increase rather than stagnation.
Rain-bearing cloud and fertile growth make honoring materially productive.
Flowing and coursing provide the release path from retained source to garden.
A spring as a source of running water localizes the point of emergence.
Abundant gushing intensifies circulation into surplus.
Verdure, ease, and abundant living show the experiential yield of the water cycle.

structural_cues: The surah moves from earth, fruit, grain, and fragrance through two seas to flowing and gushing springs, gardens, and green furnishings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a held-water focus branch and contextual source, flow, gush, and verdure; I supply the causal arrow retention to circulation to growth. These images could instead remain separate gifts with no single hydrological mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Blessing is a static quantity of good possessed by the Name.
changed_reading.after: Blessing is source architecture: it holds without hoarding, releases without depletion, and turns circulation into fertile honoring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated challenge about the Lord's benefits trains a response; immediately after its final occurrence, the focus line performs durable assent by holding fast to the Name and voicing willing honor.

activation_trace.role: Holding fast makes the final acclamation a sustained answer rather than a momentary exclamation.
A formula of willing honor gives the answer an audible form of assent.
Benefits and favors are the repeated objects that call for acknowledgment.
The non-dominant image of following and succession activates the refrain as a chain whose last link leads into 55:78.
Abiding and continuance make the refrain's Lord the stable relation carried through every recurrence.
Contradiction or denial supplies the challenged response that the final acclamation reverses.

structural_cues: The same dual-address question occurs thirty-one times, with its final occurrence at 55:77 immediately before the focus verse.
The refrain's ربكما shifts to the focus verse's singular ربك.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated questions, benefits, denial, and immediate adjacency; I infer that 55:78 functions as the cultivated answer and not only narrator doxology. The narrator-only reading remains possible, and the succession branch is explicitly a non-dominant activation.

changed_reading.before: The refrain ends and an independent praise formula closes the surah.
changed_reading.after: The final praise is the response the refrain has been eliciting: persistent acknowledgment of the Name after repeated opportunities to deny.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit reciprocity of beneficence activates honoring as a gift that generates an answering gift: received good elicits praise and ethical beneficence without reducing grace to commercial exchange.

activation_trace.role: A gift offered with recompense in view supplies the provocative reciprocal structure.
Generosity and noble forbearance prevent reciprocity from collapsing into a market transaction.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit return relation.
Beneficent action appears on both sides of the return relation, making likeness ethical rather than monetary.

structural_cues: 55:60 asks whether the recompense of beneficence is anything but beneficence, placing the same noun on both sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit act-for-act return and a focus gift branch; I infer that the final acclamation can be the receiver's non-equivalent answering gift. Alternatively, 55:60 may describe divine reward alone, so the model must not imply that divine generosity needs payment.

changed_reading.before: Honoring is a one-way attribute or gift descending from the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Honoring also generates a return path: generosity elicits praise and beneficence, while remaining prior to and greater than its answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Meeting, relation-between, and pairing organize the surah's dual worlds; the final shift from dual to singular address gathers those pairs into an encounter in which each hearer faces the one Lord through the one Name.

activation_trace.role: Single sovereignty provides the common center toward which paired domains and addressees turn.
One designation gives the many pairings a shared point of recognition without erasing their differences.
A relation standing between endpoints lets distinction and connection coexist.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies encounter without forced merger.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart generalizes paired organization into the garden inventory.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly uses dual forms for two addressees, two easts and wests, two seas, two gardens, two springs, and paired fruits.
After repeated ربكما, 55:78 closes with singular ربك.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistent dual structures, paired-but-bounded encounter, and a final pronoun shift; I infer that the singular address individualizes each hearer's answer while retaining both addressees. The shift may instead be a conventional address to the Prophet or reciter with no gathering function.

changed_reading.before: The singular second person is an incidental grammatical change at the close.
changed_reading.after: The one Name gathers a world of coexisting pairs into singular encounter: each member is addressed without the pair being collapsed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it leans on the non-dominant س م م mapping for اسم and peripheral basin, lid, and tied-vessel senses. It remains anchored in focus words 1, 2, and 6 and is activated by the surah's barrier, passage, and authority sequence. Render it only as an exploratory spatial analogy, never as a lexical translation of اسم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The held-basin branch of word 1, narrow-opening split branch of word 2, and vessel-cover branch of word 6 can form one bounded-access mechanism.

activation_trace.role: A basin holding water supplies a bounded store whose benefit depends on containment.
A narrow aperture from the non-dominant split root supplies controlled access through the Name.
A plate covering a vessel supplies preservation at the container's upper boundary.
Transgressing a limit identifies the failure that the productive boundary prevents.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the traversal whose conditions are at issue.
Compelling warrant makes passage authorized rather than boundary-destroying.
Tying a vessel closed reinforces the packet's recurrent containment architecture.

changed_reading.before: The Name merely labels an unlimited abundance.
changed_reading.after: The Name can be imagined as the warranted aperture of held abundance: boundaries preserve the good and permit ordered access rather than suppressing flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the necklace sense of ك ر م is peripheral and the move from listed materials to literary composition is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in focus word 6 and in packet images of pearl, coral, and precious patterned fabric. Render it as a compositional analogy for how the surah arranges images, not as the denotation of إكرام.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The necklace branch of honoring at word 6 can make the final attribute a figure for the surah's assembled precious materials.

activation_trace.role: A necklace of strung pieces supplies the compositional frame for assembled honor.
The Name gives the assembled images a named center of reference.
The pearl supplies one literal precious unit available for stringing.
Coral or bead supplies a second materially distinct unit beside pearl.
The coral image recurs in comparison, allowing one material to bind distant garden scenes.
Precious patterned carpets extend assembled honor from beads into woven surface.

changed_reading.before: Honoring is an abstract quality appended at the end.
changed_reading.after: Honoring becomes, exploratorily, the act of stringing the surah's pearls, coral, colors, and textures around the Name as one composed adornment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant branch of ك ذ ب about milk failing to remain rather than the ordinary denial branch. It stays anchored to the final refrain at 55:77 and to the focus branches of persistent, growing good. Render it only as a secondary material echo beneath propositional denial, which remains primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate's growing-good and persistence branches immediately follow the final denial question and can answer a contextual image of yield that fails to last.

activation_trace.role: Fixed, increasing good supplies the durable yield asserted by the ending.
Persistence and pressing on oppose interruption or failure to continue.
Benefits identify what is received and therefore what could fail to be acknowledged or carried forward.
Abiding lordship supplies the durable source against which failed yield is measured.
Milk disappearing and not lasting activates denial as a failure of received good to continue yielding.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only saying that the benefits are false.
changed_reading.after: Beneath that primary sense, denial can also picture received good failing to endure or yield; the final blessing counters it with inexhaustible, persistent increase.

strongest_changes: The near-parallel with 55:26-27 turns the Name into a recitable interface with abiding presence after finite forms disappear.
55:29 turns lordship and blessing into continuous responsive maintenance rather than static rank and stored good.
Teaching, articulation, calculation, and balance make the Name a legible signature of cosmic and ethical measure.
The thirty-onefold refrain makes 55:78 a cultivated answer of durable assent, while the singular address individualizes that answer.
Water, spring, flow, gush, fertility, and verdure make blessing a retention-and-circulation ecology.
summary.what_was_special: The closing line supports several live mechanisms at once: settling and rising, naming and marking, persistence and renewal, singular address amid paired worlds, and material containment that enables rather than blocks abundance. Non-dominant mapped roots opened real but explicitly contained readings instead of being collapsed into the dominant target.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet provides no branch inventory for ج ل ل, so its repeated position can support structure but not a branch-specific mechanism.
The Name/Face relation may be theological mediation, rhetorical ring closure, or both; the packet does not force one ontology.
The mark, aperture, succession, necklace, gift-for-return, and failed-yield activations rely on split or peripheral branches and must remain exploratory.
Causal arrows such as request to maintenance and retention to circulation are abductive reader constructions; the packet supplies their elements but not the direction.
